results.id: L|Package\Update Standing Order First Transaction Received|short
results.detail: I re-derived the units from the SqlCommand at DTSX:3975-4012 and from update Standing Order main.cs (DTSX:4092, sha 0d253194…). These units are correct. [1]: the filters are gen_isfirsttransactionreceivied = 0 and gen_ispastrecord = 0 (DTSX:3987-3988), with no statecode/statuscode filter. [2]: the conditions are '53'/'02' (DTSX:3989-3990); bank via gen_banks.Gen_BankNumber = ft.Gen_CurrentAccountBank (DTSX:3994); branch equality (DTSX:3993); account number right(13 zeros + x, 12) on both sides (DTSX:3992), which I accept as 'same account' because leading zeros are ignored; amount and date per depositType = 2 / <> 2 with '<=' (DTSX:3996-4009); a NULL depositType matches neither branch. The table meaning is labelled השערה. [6]: an order that is not updated keeps flag 0 and is read again next run. [7]: ROW_NUMBER partitions by ft.gen_transtotalamount, so.gen_bankname, so.gen_bankaccountnumber, so.gen_branch, with RowNum = 1 (DTSX:3978, 4012). Each order falls in one partition, because its amount is fixed by depositType, so only one order per combination is marked. The hedge in [8] about '53'/'02' and 'first transaction' is correct. What is missing is a written attribute. The write in unit [4], and the outcome in unit [8], name only statuscode = 100000009. The script also sets gen_isfirsttransactionreceivied = true in the same service.Update (main.cs:127, DTSX:4341). This second write is business logic: it is why a marked order is not selected again (filter = 0 at DTSX:3987). Contrast unit [6], where an order that is not marked is re-checked.

wrongUnits.problem: Only statuscode = 100000009 is listed. The script also writes gen_isfirsttransactionreceivied = true in the same Update.
wrongUnits.correct: הוראת הקבע מעודכנת דרך ה-SDK (Update): statuscode = 100000009 (FIRST_TRANSACTION_RECEIVED) ו-gen_isfirsttransactionreceivied = true, ולכן לא תיבחר שוב בריצות הבאות.
